content_fields.title: Verify that the use of client certificate bundles for unprivileged users is enforced (Docker)
content_fields.description: Verify that client certificate bundles are actually required for unprivileged control-plane access.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means attempting control-plane access without a bundle and confirming it is refused, and confirming that issued bundles carry the correct role and expiry.
content_fields.found: No orchestration control plane is present in this deployment.
content_fields.missing: The control plane and its access logs against which the verification would be performed.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification cannot be performed without the platform it targets.
content_fields.action: The container platform team should perform this verification on the orchestration control plane.
